name: Quiet Admin – disable comments, hide notices, and clean dashboard widgets
author: Element Media LLC

sections.description:
Tired of a messy WordPress admin full of notices, unused widgets, and unwanted comment clutter? Quiet Admin helps you create a cleaner, distraction-free wp-admin so you can focus on what matters.

Features

  • 🛑 Hide Notices: Choose to hide non-critical notices, or silence all admin notices temporarily.
  • 💬 Disable Comments: Turn off comments site-wide, or selectively by post type.
  • 📋 Clean Dashboard Widgets: Remove default WordPress widgets and plugin widgets with a live dashboard manager.
  • ⚡ Lightweight & Fast: Built for performance, with no bloat.
  • 🎯 Simple UI: Everything is in one place — no complicated settings.

Quiet Admin is perfect for agencies, freelancers, and site owners who want to streamline their admin dashboard and improve productivity.

👉 Learn more and find tips on using Quiet Admin at Element Media.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Quiet Admin.
  3. To manage dashboard widgets, visit your Dashboard and append ?qa_manage=1 to the URL.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin speed up my WordPress dashboard?

Yes. By removing unnecessary widgets and notices, it can slightly improve performance and create a faster, cleaner admin experience.

Can I bring back hidden notices or widgets?

Yes. All changes are reversible through the Quiet Admin settings panel.

Is it safe to disable comments?

Absolutely. Disabling comments through Quiet Admin simply removes comment functionality where you choose — it won’t break your site.

Where can I get support?

You can open a ticket on the WordPress.org support forum or visit our website for additional resources.
